in_sanskrit.name: शर्वण्क
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शर्वण् (sharvaṇ) means abundance and क (k) is a suffix that denotes the possessor. So Sharvank means God of abundance.

in_hindi.name: शर्वंक
in_hindi.long_meaning: अभि (abhi) means towards and लाष (lāṣ) means desire. So Sharvank means one who desires towards something.

in_tamil.name: ஶர்வங்க
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஶர்வ (śarv) means God and ங்க (ṅg) is a suffix that denotes the possessor. So Sharvank means God's possession.

in_telugu.name: శర్వంగ
in_telugu.long_meaning: శర్వ (śarv) means God and ఙ్గ (ṅg) is a suffix that denotes the possessor. So Sharvank means God's possession.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Sharvank' is derived from the name of Lord Sharva, a significant deity in Hinduism. The name holds cultural significance as it is associated with Lord Sharva, who is revered as the God of Knowledge and the God of Six Directions. He is considered to be the protector of the universe and is often invoked for wisdom, success, and good fortune. The name 'Sharvank' carries the esteem and respect associated with the deity and may signify an individual with qualities akin to Lord Sharva, such as knowledge, intelligence, and a strong connection to the divine.

It is believed that invoking Lord Sharva through this name can bestow the individual with his blessings of knowledge, wisdom, and protection. The name can serve as a constant reminder of the individual's connection to the divine and can inspire a sense of devotion and faith in the Hindu deity. Overall, 'Sharvank' represents a strong spiritual connection to Lord Sharva and his qualities, providing a source of inspiration, guidance, and protection.
